impression_before_control_labels: A warm, quiet adult work portrait in a tactile bookbinding room. The bobbed face, downward gaze, ochre knit and large rounded near arm draw attention first; the book and cream thread then establish the repair action, with the wet alley providing a visible pause after rain.
initial_direction_realization: The everyday repair moment and tactile cloth/knit relation are coherent. Body presence reads strongly, but the prominent chest and horizontal knit bunching compete with the intended local lower-belly contour, while the near arm obscures the lateral torso curve.

sensual.perceived_expression: Everyday bodily presence and fitted knit read as a supporting attractive quality in the ordinary work scene; no measured intensity or user preference is claimed.

fetish.perceived_expression: No independent fetish-directed scenario was added.

creativity.perceived_expression: The scene stays close to the independently authored book-repair direction.

surreal.perceived_expression: The frame reads as ordinary photographic space and material behavior.
